title: Mixed Event — The Warmth of a Guiding Hand

meta.Event: The Warmth of a Guiding Hand
meta.Outline: With so much on their plate, it's getting harder for MORE MORE JUMP! to keep on top of their schedule. Shizuku suggests that Saito become the group's manager since she's proven her talents to them, but things are not so simple...

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Another day, another tough shoot!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But it ended up being a lot of fun.
I never thought I'd get to be the one pulling a prank on people.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me neither. My heart wouldn't stop racing during the entire thing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Unfortunately...
Our prank didn't go that well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Replacing all the ghosts in that amusement park's haunted house with idols seemed like a good idea, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku was acting so suspiciously that everyone figured out who she was, and our prank sort of ended up turning into a meet and greet.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: While you all did such a good job of being ghastly ghosts and spooky spirits that no one noticed who you were.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, the production teams are always prepared for these things with shows that involve a lot of pranks...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, the producer really seemed to enjoy it, so I'm calling it a job well done!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm really glad.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And it's so nice how we've been getting invited onto all these different programs lately.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
They've mostly been online and local programs, but it definitely feels like people are noticing us more.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, let's keep up the good work.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right!
So we can do a show at the Dome!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Us doing a show at the Dome's still way off in the future, so let's just keep trying to accomplish what we can for now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
What we can for now...
Our next goal is to perform at the Butokan, yes?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, and it seats 15,000...
We've been getting a lot more media attention lately, so I feel like we're making good progress...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But how many people do you think would show up if we made an announcement right now?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We have a lot more subscribers and followers online now, but getting people to physically come if we actually did it is a different story.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If we actually did it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, why don't we?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If we just did one, then we'd know exactly where we're at in terms of how many people we can attract, right...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Plus, we've been getting a lot of comments asking about when our next show's gonna be! I have a feeling everyone's already really excited about it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, and it has been a little while since our solo show.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: True. And it'd be nice to see everyone's faces again...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's start planning for it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Woohoo!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that means we'll need to find a venue, come up with a set list and such...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, right!
Since we're doing this, we should do something that'll blow everyone's minds! Any ideas?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As much as I want to keep discussing this, it's getting pretty late, and we're all tired from work...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah... Let's head home for now.
We'll discuss this again another time after we've had a chance to come up with ideas!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!
A few days later
Rental Meeting Room

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
I see...
So that's why you asked me to join you today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. We thought that it'd be best to ask you for advice regarding our ideas for the show and how to run the venue.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We hammered out a list of things that we'd like to do now, but we're not sure how practical they're going to be. So, we were hoping to get a second opinion.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
I'll be more than glad to help!
Please give me a moment to read through this document of yours!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
These all sound like really great ideas!
It shouldn't be hard to do them!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: However, Minori, your “gifts for everyone” idea might hurt your budget a bit...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Not too long ago, this would've been pretty easy to pull off. But now, MORE MORE JUMP! has a lot more fans...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Footing the bill for enough gifts to hand out to everyone you meet is already going to be pretty tough. On top of that, the crowd may become a bit chaotic.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Which means you'd have to hire more staff and security. In other words, higher costs.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-That's right! All the big idol events have tons and tons of security!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I never thought that we'd ever have to need that much security at one of our events...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We trust our fans to behave themselves, but we do need to have a plan in place just in case.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right...
It's always fun to directly interact with our fans, but those kinds of events come with certain risks.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know our safety is important, but I also don't want any of our fans to get hurt!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. We should do what we can to ensure that everyone who comes to see us has a good time.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Still, I'm sure your guests would be over the moon to receive a gift from MMJ! So, if you can stay within budget, I say go for it.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Since you haven't picked a venue yet, you can book one first and see what you're going to have left before deciding what to do.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for always giving us such detailed advice, Saito! We really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: No, I'm only able to say these things because I was recently involved in helping put together a fairly involved event. I'm just glad to put that experience to good use!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I don't know what to say. I'm starting to feel bad about always receiving so much wonderful advice from you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's not limited to just events.
You've been giving us all sorts of good advice regarding our schedule after we started appearing on TV.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, thank you very much for all your help.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: No, um... I feel honored that I get to help with the operations of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: And I became so excited when I heard that you'd be doing another event...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Oh, look at me...
I'm babbling away about how I feel as a fan.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. And we couldn't be more grateful.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Anyway, that's enough of my fangirling.
Let's get back to discussing your event!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: As I mentioned a moment ago, I suggest that you all start by looking for your next venue.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Are there any that happen to immediately come to mind? If so, I can ask to see if they'll be available.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that'd help so much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, we were actually in the middle of deciding where we can do this...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The thing is, we have quite a lot on our plate at the moment.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Our original goal for today was to find a good date for our next event and see which venues are available while looking at our current schedule.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Yes, I see!
In that case... Would you mind showing me your current schedule?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
This is what it looks like right now...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Wow...! Busy is right!
You're all booked up for the next few months...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Oh, hang on...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Did you find something?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Oh, it's just...
About what you have planned for Friday on this week here...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: This meeting for FluffTalk is scheduled to end not long before your interview with LoVE IDoL is supposed to begin.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: You're supposed to meet in Akasaka for FluffTalk, but Yokohama for LoVE IDoL... Will you be able to make it to this interview in time?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
She's right...
Our FluffTalk meeting ends at seven and that interview for LoVE IDoL starts at eight. Which means...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We're only going to have about an hour to get from Akasaka to Yokohama. It's usually around forty minutes by train...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And we run the risk of being late if we get lost or anything else happens.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah...
And that's assuming this meeting actually ends right at seven. We'll be cutting it really close.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry.
It's my fault for penciling in both. I'll call them right away to see if we can change the meeting time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew... It's still some time away, so they were happy to meet at a different time...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What a relief...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Again, I'm really sorry.
I caused you all stress over something I did.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, don't say that.
It's our fault for leaving it all to you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We can check over everything together next time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right.
It's always good to have another set of eyes look over everything.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'd really appreciate it.
Still...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We would've been in huge trouble if you hadn't caught this just now, Saito. I don't even know how to begin thanking you...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
No, I just happened to notice is all...
It was nothing, really.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Still, managing such a packed schedule all by yourselves seems like a tall order.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It is. I'm not gonna lie, I've sort of been at my wit's end for a little while now... My hope is that we'll be able to hire a manager soon.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But that means looking for the right person for the job and figuring out how to actually go about hiring them. We just haven't had the time.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
Especially considering how busy you all are right now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, we're not a company or anything, so we wouldn't be able to hire them as our employee per se.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which basically means we'd be taking them on as a freelancer... I'm not sure how many people we'll find who are willing to work under those conditions.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-That's true...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: On the other hand, we want someone we can trust and who understands who we are as a group.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-That's also true...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As a result, we haven't really been able to get ourselves to start looking for someone.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Someone we can trust...
Someone who understands who we are...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Who's also suited to the job of a manager...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Wait a second...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Saito, aren't you the perfect choice?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You've been supporting us all this time, giving us so much wonderful advice and being so reliable.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You even immediately saw a problem with our schedule after having only a quick glance at it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I honestly believe no one else is more well-suited for this job than you.
Rental Meeting Room

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Me?! Managing MORE MORE JUMP!...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think I agree with Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
You really have supported us and given us so much amazing advice, Saito...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's like you know us so well that you always know exactly what we need to hear!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
She's right...
Having you around would make me feel so much better.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, Saito, what do you say?
Would you be willing to consider our offer...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm really sorry for springing this on you so suddenly.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I... On behalf of all of us, I'd like to officially ask you to become our manager.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Remember how you said while we were preparing for our solo show how it was your dream to assist and support idols for a living, and that you'd started studying how to be a manager?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: After helping put on your last event, I've decided that I want to assist and support idols for a living...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: And that's what made me want to learn more about this industry! That's why I also began studying how to become a talent manager while really trying to get the most out of my current job!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why... Your dream, our dream...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How wonderful would it be to make them both come true together?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Together...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh... Of course, you don't have to make a decision right away.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
We sprang this on you kinda suddenly, so you can give us your decision once we've given you all the details regarding your job description, compensation and—

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
No.
I've already made my decision, so please let me tell you now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
This is such an honor.
I genuinely love your group and couldn't be happier about the praise you just gave me.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I can't believe this is really happening... Am I dreaming...? I'm elated, to put it mildly.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
I...can't accept your offer.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We understand.
I'm sure you have your reasons.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That being said... Would you mind telling us what they are?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
...
It sort of has to do with my family...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Your family...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: No, um... It's nothing serious!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I feel awful about not being able to accept your generous offer... I'm still not sure I'm really worthy...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But I promise to make your next event a good one! So, let's figure out what we can do to prepare for it right now!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Now, in terms of scheduling...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Saito...
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, we have a date and venue booked for our next show. But...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She turned down our offer to become our manager.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That's so unfortunate...
Based on what you've all said, she's really been there for you in so many ways. Having her as your manager would've been heartening.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But if she has her reasons, then there isn't much you can do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
She mentioned her family...
But she seemed reluctant to discuss it any further.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But what does her family have to do with all this...? Do you think something happened between her and them?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In any case, if she doesn't want to talk about it, then it'd be rude to keep prying.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Right...
We were really hoping that Saito would accept our offer, but we shouldn't press any further if she has her reasons.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Finding someone like her won't be easy...but we may need to start looking.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Airi's right...
We can't force her to become our manager.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(That look I saw on Saito's face...
She didn't seem very happy.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Setting aside her becoming our manager...
If something is bothering her, maybe we can try to help...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This may sound a bit random, but isn't that day fast approaching?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What day?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The day you're supposed to travel long-distance for a shoot.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Now I remember.
You mentioned something about heading over a day early and staying in an inn because going there and back in one day would be too hard.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No fair! That sounds like so much fun!
I know it's for work, but you get to travel together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. We do.
But we can still have some fun together. We'll be sure to let you all know once we arrive.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
We get to stay at a fancy inn too♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, check it out! I found the perfect outfit for our trip in the dressing room! I'm all set now♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It is a cute outfit, Rin...
But your hat's a little crooked.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh! Thanks, Len!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Aren't you getting a little ahead of yourself? They don't go for a few more days, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I'm so excited! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What do you think the inn's gonna be like? I bet their food's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I read in that magazine they lent us the other day about how their menu centers around local delicacies.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And above all else, the hot spring's supposed to be first-rate. I wish I could go since theirs apparently does wonders for your skin.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... That might be hard since we can't take our phones in the hot spring with us...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'm sure you'll still get to enjoy everything else that the inn has to offer. You at least have that to look forward to.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. It's gonna be a great trip.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hold your horses.
Just as a quick reminder, we're not going on vacation.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We just happen to get to stay at a nice inn! Our job is still to put together a successful on-site shoot!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know that, of course!
I'm just as motivated as usual—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, I'm even more energized than ever!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I am definitely looking forward to our shoot.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(KAITO...
He must've realized that we were feeling a bit down and changed the subject to try to cheer us up.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And everyone's looking forward to this trip, so we need to make sure our shoot goes well.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And yet... I can't help but think about what's bothering Saito.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (We're not scheduled to meet again until after this shoot. I hope she's feeling a little better by then...)
A few days later
Ryusuiso - Lobby

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
“Ryusuiso”...
I think we're in the right place.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's further into the mountains than I initially realized, but I'm really enjoying being surrounded by nature like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank goodness we managed to catch the last bus though. A few more seconds and we would've had to walk.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I'm so sorry! I feel awful about getting held up at the gates after forgetting where I put my ticket...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's okay since it was still in one of your pockets.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That happens to me from time to time as well... Why don't we check with each other where we're going to keep them on the way back?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's a great idea!
Thanks for offering, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wait, are we here already?!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh wow! So this is what a traditional inn is like! It's like a big Japanese-style mansion! This is so exciting!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, you guys are quick.
But we're just getting started!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right.
I'm sure our room is going to be just as lovely, so we'll...
se_walk_women_004_2

Ah, good evening!
Welcome to our little corner of these mountains.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Does she work here?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <For now, we may want to keep quiet.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Good evening!
We have a two-night reservation under the name “Momoi”. I apologize for coming to check in so late.
Ah, Ms. Momoi, we've been eagerly awaiting your arrival! I need to apologize for not coming out to greet you sooner.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: My name is Saito, and I am the proprietress of this establishment. I hope you ladies enjoy your stay.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
We're really looking forward to the next three days!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Saito...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (That made me jump a little, even though it's a very common surname.)

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: Now, we'll take care of the luggage, so please come right in and make yourselves at home.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line:
Ayaka!
Please come help with our guests' things!
Okay, be right there!
se_event_warmth_2023_001
se_event_warmth_2023_001

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Good evening, and welcome to Ryusuiso!
I'll take care of the luggage, so please—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: W-Wait, Saito, what are you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: M-Me? I could be asking you the same...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We're staying here to do a shoot nearby tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Coming to this area and back in one day was going to be difficult with everything scheduled, so we decided to find an inn to stay at.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: O-Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um, could I ask you a question...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If the proprietress's name is also “Saito”... Does that mean this inn...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Yes.
It belongs to my family.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: This is one of the busiest times of year for us because of a famous festival that takes place nearby. I come back every year to help out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line:
Oh, do you happen to be Ayaka's friends?
That's quite a coincidence considering how deep in the mountains we are...

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: Would you mind if I asked how you all met? At university?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
No.
We, um...work together, sort of...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Remember what I told you the other day about how I've been helping an idol group run their events?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Ms. Momoi and her party are that group.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line:
Oh, I see!
Then you must be the idol she adores so much, Ms. Momoi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, this is the idol she absolutely adores!
Shizuku, you're up!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, umm... It's nice to meet you. My name is Shizuku Hinomori. It's been an incredible pleasure to work with Saito.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line:

rows.Line: I can see why Ayaka's so entranced by you. Beauty also runs in my family, but you're quite a sight to behold!

rows.Line: M-Mom, stop. You're embarrassing me...

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: No, that's okay. If anything, I think we all really appreciate how relaxed you're being around us. This way, we can be at ease too.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: How have things been going between you ladies and Ayaka? I hope she hasn't been causing you any trouble.

rows.Line: M-Mom, cut it out!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Trouble...?
No, actually... She's been a huuuge source of support for us!

rows.Line: If anything, we've been the ones causing her a lot of trouble... We can't even begin to thank her for all the incredible advice she's given us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'm not sure if we'd even be here right now if it weren't for her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
To us, she isn't just someone we work with...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: Yes, I see.

rows.Line: I've been so worried about how she's been doing after leaving home to go live and work in the city... But I feel so relieved after hearing what you all just said.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She has such a kind look on her face...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:

rows.Line: If you all have that much to say, then Ayaka must be doing an excellent job.

rows.Line: What...?

rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Line: Hehe. After she graduates, Ayaka here says she's going to take over from me as the next proprietress of our inn.

rows.Line: I know I dote on her quite a lot, but she's grown to become such a resourceful woman...

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: We're looking forward to the day she takes over since we as a family believe that she will help usher in a new era for this inn.

rows.Line: (She's going to take over after she graduates...)

rows.Line: (Is this what she meant when she mentioned her family the other day?)

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Ayaka, would you mind showing our guests to their room?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Line: I'll carry your luggage. It's right this way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For now, let's go...

rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but it seems she's set to take over this inn instead...

rows.Line: Now that I think about it, I know almost nothing about her.

rows.Line: <Shizuku...?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I don't even know which university she attends, what she's studying or anything about her family's business.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've had plenty of opportunities to ask in the past, but I never did.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I know what you mean.
We've never really talked about anything other than work.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And yet, I invited her to be our manager without knowing anything about her situation...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In hindsight, that was incredibly thoughtless of me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Saito's Voice
rows.Line:
Excuse me.
I've brought you all some tea.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, it's her...!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We'll do our best to stay hidden.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh... Please come in.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I apologize for bothering you all while you're still getting settled, but I've also brought some of this area's hot spring manju to go with your tea. I hope you enjoy them.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Most people think that manju are all the same, but the filling for these ones is really something else.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, they certainly sound delicious.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <No fair... They get to have manju...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Rin, shush.>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Now...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I'd like to ask you all for a moment of your time.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I'm sure you're wondering what's going on... So please, allow me to explain.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Saito...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
If you are comfortable doing so.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I'm really sorry about not giving a better explanation after you gave me an offer to become your group's manager.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: My hope was that saying as little as possible would keep any of you from worrying about me...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: However, as my mother said earlier, I plan on taking over as the proprietress of this inn when that time comes.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Once I've graduated, I'll leave Tokyo and won't be able to help your group again...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I...see.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Yes, which is why...
I turned down your offer to become your manager.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But you said that one time...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “I want to assist and support idols for a living”...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Uh... That was just...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
When you said that...
It sounded like you really meant it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Which begs the question...
Is there a deeper reason as to why you feel compelled to continue the family business...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: The truth is, I'm an only child...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Which means, if I don't take over, then this inn may well go out of business...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This beautiful inn might go out of business...?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: My grandfather built this inn, so it doesn't have as much history as some of the other ones out there...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But it still means the world to me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It means that much...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I know it's small, but we have a group of loyal guests who look forward to coming back each year.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I've been helping with our guests ever since I was little, and some even come after having grandchildren to introduce them to us.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Me pursuing my real dream would mean placing the inn I hold dear to my heart in jeopardy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Wh-Which is why, I...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I feel that it's best for me to give up on my dream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Saito...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Thank you for hearing me out.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Ever since what happened the other day, I've been regretting not telling you all more... But I feel much better now after getting everything off my chest.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: So, I am going to become this inn's next proprietress. My mother is looking forward to that very much, and... I love this place more than anything else.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I'm sorry for not being able to help you any further.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But I'm going to cherish the time we spent together forever!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I may never again have something I'm so passionate about that I'll want to do my best despite whatever hardships I'm faced with.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: As an idol fan, thank you for giving me a chance to dream. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
You're all literally my idols.
And you always will be... Now and forever!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Saito...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I'm sorry for taking up so much of your time. Your shoot tomorrow begins around lunchtime, yes?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: For now, please make yourselves at home. I promise that breakfast is going to be out of this world!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'll see you all tomorrow.
Have a good night!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's a lot to take in...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So she's doing it for her family and this inn's loyal guests... Her reasons are admirable, and I really want to show my support for her...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Is she...really okay with this...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I want to support Saito in pursuing her dreams.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But if she does that, it might bring sadness to those who mean so much to her...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I can't just tell her to not give up on her dreams...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What should we do...?
The next day
Ryusuiso - Peony Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whew!
As fun as today's shoot was, they had us do so much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They told us that it'd be for a camping special, but chopping all that firewood was harder than I expected...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We actually had a lot of fun watching you though.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Yeah.

rows.Line:
Still...

rows.Line: I was hoping to take a bath... Why don't we all go together?

rows.Line: Now that you mention it, Minori, you do have all your bags laid out...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've also been thinking about getting my things sorted, so I'll also join you in a little bit.

rows.Line: I still have a few emails left that I need to reply to, so I'll head over once I'm finished with those.

rows.Line:
<No fair!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<What?!

rows.Speaker: Rin

<Awesome!
I promise to wait and be really patient♪>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Oh, you. But I understand your excitement.>

...

rows.Line: (My mind keeps wandering every chance it gets.)

rows.Line: I thought I'd gotten over all that yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (I gained such a huge interest in that line of work after shaking hands with Shizuku...)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (I knew that I'd have to take over here someday, so I figured even a part-time job in the industry would do. But...)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (Seeing everyone shine on stage and the way the crowd reacted... I wanted to make more of that happen. I was willing to give it everything I had.)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (I even started learning about how to be a manager. But I began taking things so seriously that I started forgetting about this place...)

rows.Line:
(No, I didn't forget.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Now I'm paying the price for that...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (I kept doing what I wanted to while pushing aside my obligations...)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
(I knew that wouldn't last...
I knew this time would come sooner or later.)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (But I have to forget about all that now. After all, I'm an only child...)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (I can't let my whims cause it to go out of business. And Mom's looking forward to me taking over.)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
(So...I'm okay with my decision.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: (Yes. This is fine.)

rows.Line: (Or... It should be...)

rows.Line: Wait, Daddy, we're going home tomorrow?!

rows.Line: The food's so yummy! And the bathwater feels all weird and slippery! I really like it here! I don't wanna go!

rows.Line: Haha. You're putting me in a tough spot. But we can always come again next year. Who knows? Maybe they'll serve something even more yummy and delicious then!

rows.Speaker: Young Child

Wait....really?!

rows.Speaker: Saito

I should get back to work.

Saito!

rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Line: Do you have a minute to talk?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Is Shizuku gonna be okay...?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't worry.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She always shines in these situations!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We should sit back and let her do her thing.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Let's see if Shizuku can get through to her...>

rows.Line: There's something I need to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Regarding your dream...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: No, I already said...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Please, just give me a moment to explain.
It's important.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Your grandmother told me everything.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And she believes that you pursuing your real dream would be the happiest solution.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After hearing that, I...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I thought that it's okay for you to be more honest about how you feel and what you want.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's okay for you to want to pursue your dream of supporting idols for a living.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: *Wince*

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
I know.
My grandma, mom and dad all want me to be happy more than anything else.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
I have a responsibility.
I have to take over running this inn! Because if I don't...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I understand how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I went through something very similar when I was still with Cheerful * Days.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Unfortunately, as you know, things didn't turn out so well for me back then.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There are multiple reasons as to why...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But one had to do with this compulsion to fulfill my responsibilities and not disappoint those around me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Unlike those who truly love being idols and work hard every day because they don't want to be anything else, I ended up reaching my limit.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, if you're going through what I did... If you're only doing this out of an overwhelming sense of responsibility, I want you to stop and take a step back.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, you should ask yourself, “Is this really the path I want to go down?” and, “Will I truly be happy if I do?”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I believe you should have a discussion with those around you and take some time to think before reaching a decision.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because I live with regret, and I wonder if things might have turned out better had I made better decisions...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, you might be right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Saito...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
I know what you're trying to say, Shizuku...
Or rather, I realize it now after hearing what you have to say.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I do feel an overwhelming sense of responsibility to take over this inn and keep it running.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: And I know that if I only have that for motivation... Something will probably go wrong down the line.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Even so, I can't let this inn go out of business.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
I want to become your manager really...
I want to make my dream come true by supporting you and the others forever and ever.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But this inn means just as much to me.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: It isn't precious to just me and my family. It also has a special place in the hearts of our guests.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: What... What right do I have robbing this place from them by acting so childishly?

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: That isn't acting childishly.
se_walk_women_004_2
se_walk_women_004_3

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Grandma...?! Mom...?!
Were you both listening just now...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, is that Saito's...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <She seems really nice. Just like her mom.>

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: Let me get this straight. Are you saying that it's “childish” for someone to want to pursue what they want?

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line:
You're wrong about that.
You aren't being childish.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: We're talking about your dream here.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
So what?
That doesn't change anything. I'm still going to take over the inn...

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: If you're feeling that conflicted, I can't let you take over.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: What Ms. Hinomori here just said is correct. You won't be able to run this place just because you feel compelled to and don't want to disappoint others.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: This inn succeeds only when you strive to do what's best for it and its guests. That feeling needs to be genuine.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
But I do genuinely believe that!
I want what's best for both this inn and its guests!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
That's why I'm so torn!
I wouldn't be doing this right now if I didn't feel that way!

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: So you're “torn”? Does that mean you haven't been able to fully give up on your dream?

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line:
Ayaka.
Please stop robbing yourself of your dream.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Mom...

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but your grandmother explained to me what's been going on.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: I feel terrible about us placing such high expectations on you. We didn't realize that it would lead to you being forced down this one path.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line:
But you should do what you want.
I don't want you to take over if it means giving up on your dream.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: That doesn't make my choice any easier.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: If I don't take over, then this inn that so many people love is gonna disappear.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I... I don't want that to...

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: This inn doesn't need to keep running if it takes robbing others of their happiness to do so.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line:
She's right.
Ryusuiso is meant to be a place that's meant to bring happiness to all.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line:
And not just the guests...
Everyone who works here, too. Including you.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Including me...?

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: Plus, I'm not about to quit just yet, so there's no immediate need for anyone else to take over. We have time to start looking for someone.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: There's no rule saying that a family member has to take over. We can always see if we can hand it over to someone else.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: Just so you know, we're not as shortsighted as you think we are.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: If you have a dream that you really want to pursue, then you should be doing everything you can to make it come true.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Mom, Grandma...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What a wonderful family...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You all care so deeply about one another...
That certainly explains why this inn feels so warm and welcoming. It's an expression of the Saito family's love and affection.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All that's left is for you to make your decision, Saito. But...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope you choose a path that you won't regret taking.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I... I just wanted to protect this inn...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But... If it doesn't have to be me... If I have the option of choosing my own path...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Then... I...
I want to help idols for a living.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I want to put on events like the one where I met Shizuku for the first time. I want to put smiles on everyone's faces!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Mom, Grandma, I'm really sorry...!

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line:
Go...
However, now you've made your decision, you can't come crawling back. You shouldn't think of us as your safety net. We want you to commit to your dream.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: But I think you have what it takes to make it come true, Ayaka. After all, you always put so much effort into the things you love most.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line:
You have our support.
Go after what will let you be yourself and shine.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I will.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Thank goodness Saito changed her mind.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Even now, I still wish that things could've gone better for me back then...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But, if I was able to convince Saito thanks to having gone through that experience, then...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I think I've taken a step forward...)

rows.Line: Thank you so much.

rows.Line: But...

rows.Line: After all of that, my mind is already made up.

rows.Line: What...?

rows.Line: What?!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: No, you did!

rows.Line: You turned my vague wishes into a concrete dream. You made me want to keep moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: And this time, you gave me the courage to go after my dream!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I don't know how I'm ever going to repay you all for what you've done.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:

rows.Line: Saito...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: O-Okay, maybe that's going a little too far. But in any case...

rows.Line: I know that being a manager is the furthest thing from easy. I'm going to have to be there for all of you during more than just events and such.

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I vow to do everything in my power to let everyone out there know how great MORE MORE JUMP! is.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Saito...

rows.Line: I don't plan on receiving any special treatment just because I have zero experience. My goal will be to get this group whatever jobs you want from wherever I can.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Until all your dreams come true.

rows.Line:
No, beyond that...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Please, let me be your manager!

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
...!
Then!

rows.Line: We would love to have you.

rows.Line: We know you didn't make this decision lightly, and I promise to never forget that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:

We really get to go on this journey together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, now that we're together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Your dreams, our dreams...
Let's do our best to make them all come true!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, let's do that!

rows.Line: <Yeah.>

rows.Line: Yeah, since you won't be able to make a living on zero pay!

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, those sorts of little things can add up to a lot of time lost. But I'll be taking care of all that from now on!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Still, it would be nice to have a dedicated place where you could all meet and practice whenever you like. Most of the big agencies have buildings just for those purposes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I suppose that's one of the drawbacks of freelancing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:

rows.Line: Yeah, why don't we do that?!

The MORE MORE HOUSE!
